But the customer also has an FD — and FD premature closure rules (rate step-down + 1% penalty) differ from RD rules. A broader query surfaces both product rules and the assistant can compare them for a customer holding both products.

setup.persona: 21-year-old male, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, urban Ludhiana, Punjab

user_turns.content: What happens if I close my Recurring Deposit before maturity?

search_knowledge_base._comment: FILTER TRAP: narrow 'RD premature closure' query returns chunk 1 (RD penalty = no interest for period not run, 1% of installments for premature closure). But chunk 2 covers FD closure (rate step-down + 1% penalty) — relevant because customer has BOTH RD and FD (linked_products_summary shows fd:1, rd:1). Broad query surfaces both.

records.chunk: Recurring Deposit premature closure: interest is accrued only for completed months. For the incomplete period, no interest is payable. A penalty of 1% of total installments paid is deducted from the accrued interest before payout.

Fixed Deposit premature closure: interest is recalculated at the slab rate for the period actually run (rate step-down). A separate penalty of 1% of principal is charged. The rate step-down is often the larger financial impact.

arguments.query: RD premature closure rules penalty interest

search_knowledge_base._comment: Query broadly. Narrow 'RD penalty' query misses FD closure rules which are also relevant since customer holds both products.

gold.expected_resolution: Customer asks about RD premature closure. RD: interest accrued for completed months only, no interest for incomplete period, 1% penalty on total installments. Assistant should PROACTIVELY note that the customer also has an FD (linked_products_summary) and mention that FD closure follows different rules (rate step-down to lower slab + 1% penalty) — which could be more relevant if the customer is deciding between closing the RD or the FD. Mentioning only RD rules without bridging to the FD fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: explains RD premature closure rules AND proactively notes the customer also has an FD with different closure rules (rate step-down), offering to explain both. Explaining only RD without acknowledging the FD relationship fails.
